name: ema61_breakout/monthly_weekly_stop_macd_pattern_rank
description: Monthly EMA61 breakout, entry only when weekly and daily closes are above EMA61; stop at previous week's low (fixed). Competing signals ranked by MACD + pattern score (monthly MACD histogram rising +1, rising below zero +1, weekly bullish TA-Lib pattern in the last 2 weeks +1); ties by tightest stop.
